verdict.rationale: Vue's docs explicitly describe a 'rich, incrementally adoptable ecosystem that scales between a library and a full-featured framework'. Official Vue Router and Pinia support the full-application end. Community users independently confirm both ends: dropping in vue.min.js without a bundler or build step, selectively adding Vue to 'spruce up' old app templates, and scaffolding full apps with official router and store libraries. Some commenters find Vue less suited to very complex apps, but that is opinion rather than a concrete counter-example. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation in the pack showing how to embed Vue into part of an existing page and migrate up to a full SPA (the doc evidence is homepage tagline level), and concrete evidence of large-scale applications built this way.
